Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class DownloadRecord

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.DownloadRecord
public class DownloadRecord extends Object
A file the browser has fetched (or is fetching): the source URL, the local file name it was saved under, the transfer size, a DownloadRecord.Status and the timestamp.

JavaFX's WebView has no full download manager, so the browser intercepts navigations that resolve to a non-renderable content type, saves the bytes with the JDK java.net.http client and records the result here. The record is honest about the outcome: a DownloadRecord.Status.FAILED entry keeps the error rather than pretending the file arrived.

    • updateProgress

      public void updateProgress(long bytesSoFar, long totalBytes)
      Records incremental transfer progress while the download is still running. Does not change a terminal state (DownloadRecord.Status.COMPLETE, DownloadRecord.Status.FAILED, DownloadRecord.Status.CANCELLED) so a late progress callback cannot resurrect a finished download.
      Parameters:
      bytesSoFar - bytes written to disk (clamped non-negative)
      totalBytes - expected total, or 0 when unknown (clamped non-negative)
